name: Towne Center At Fayetteville
summary: The Towne Center at Fayetteville is a 575,000 square-foot lifestyle center designed as a charming village square, featuring major retailers like Target, Kohl's, and L.L. Bean alongside specialty shops and dining. Conveniently located near major highways in the Syracuse area, it serves as Central New York's premier mixed-use shopping and community destination.
demographics: The Towne Center at Fayetteville serves a prosperous Central New York market with an average household income of $73,644 and a trade area population of 290,910. The center attracts middle to upper-middle income families and professionals seeking a mix of everyday shopping and specialty retail experiences. Primary visitors include suburban households from Fayetteville and surrounding Syracuse metropolitan communities who value the convenience of having major retailers, dining, and professional services in one location. The demographic profile skews toward established families and working professionals aged 30-65 who appreciate the traditional village square atmosphere combined with modern retail amenities.
description: The Towne Center at Fayetteville is a distinctive lifestyle shopping destination in Central New York, thoughtfully designed to replicate the warmth and charm of a traditional American village square. Spanning 46 acres with over 575,000 square feet of retail and professional space, this center brings together the region's most varied mix of tenants in a welcoming open-air environment. Strategically located at the corner of NYS Route 5 (E. Genesee St.) and Burdick Street with easy access to I-481, I-90, and I-81, the center serves as a convenient hub for the greater Syracuse area. Major anchors include Target, Kohl's, L.L. Bean, and TOPS Friendly Markets, complemented by popular specialty retailers like Warby Parker, Athleta, Ann Taylor LOFT, and Stickley Furniture. The center's diverse tenant mix extends beyond shopping to include dining options such as Bonefish Grill, Carrabba's, and Panera Bread, as well as a 36,000 square-foot Professional-Physicians' Office Building, YMCA fitness center, and various service providers, creating a true mixed-use community gathering place.
